desc: Read N, K, and array A.
Precompute binom[K][t] for 0≤t≤K, and powers of each B[i] up to K.
For each t from 0 to K, sweep j=0..N, maintaining prefix sums of B[j]^{K-t} to compute contribution \(\binom{K}{t} (-1)^{K-t} B_j^t \cdot (\text{prefix sum of } B_i^{K-t} \text{ for } i<j)\).
Sum all contributions modulo M, output.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(t, K) for t=0..K using factorials/inverses or Pascal's triangle (K small).
Compute powers of each prefix S_j iteratively: for each j, start with `cur=1` and multiply by S_j.
Maintain `pref[p]` and accumulate contribution using the binomial formula.
